$comment: Lookup table for lib/finding-disposition.mjs (aidrian pr disposition): severity x likelihood x affects [x cost] [x phase] -> disposition. What real users and operators hit routinely outranks contrived exploits; a trivial fix is always worth taking, while a structural one must earn its place. First matching rule wins. Change the table, not a prompt.

definitions.critical: harm no one can undo later: a hole in auth, tenant isolation, or payment trust, or data or money lost for good. Only critical skips the likelihood check, so a rare loss a person can refund or fix by hand is high at most, never critical
definitions.high: a real defect that breaks or corrupts a main flow for the people who hit it
definitions.medium: a real defect that degrades a flow or forces a workaround
definitions.low: polish or a nit; nobody is blocked
definitions.routine: happens in normal use within a month, with no special setup
definitions.plausible: needs one specific but realistic condition: a plan, a timing, a device, or modest attacker effort
definitions.contrived: needs a coincidence of rare conditions, or attacker effort out of proportion to the gain
definitions.users: the people the product serves: its main screens, messages, and emails
definitions.operators: the people who run the product or their business on it: admin screens, settings, notifications, day-to-day operations
definitions.revenue: money or entitlement: payments, payouts, charges, subscriptions, feature gates, plan limits, tenant data exposure
definitions.internal: only developers, tooling, logs, or the harness see it
definitions.accepted_residual: real defect, consciously not fixed: written into the pull request body as an accepted residual with a code comment, no issue. On a path where a customer buys or signs up, the residual is allowed and made visible, never answered with a refusal
definitions.acceptable_as_is: not a defect worth recording: no PR-body entry, no comment
definitions.drop_unless_cited: surface only when it cites a written project rule or a documented anti-pattern; otherwise do not report it
definitions.needs_axis: a human or user finding without likelihood and affects: classify it, never guess
definitions.trivial: a few lines, local, no new state or migration; cheaper to fix than to discuss
definitions.bounded: a contained change within the touched module, tests included
definitions.structural: new persisted state, a migration, a cross-module contract change, or a redesign
definitions.early: a person's finding, or a bot finding that arrived while the pull request had 1 to 4 bot reviews
definitions.late: a bot finding that arrived once the pull request had 5 or more bot reviews, when fixes start adding new edge cases

routine: a main screen breaks on a common phone size
a confirmation email is missing after a normal action
a toggle that should be off ships on
plausible: a race two people can hit by clicking at the same moment
a webhook retry that creates a duplicate under the provider's normal retry behaviour
a plan-limit check skipped on one of three entry points
contrived: an attacker must find an undocumented endpoint, craft a payload, and flip a database flag
two first-time setups of the same account within seconds, across an hour boundary
a provider 5xx cached under an idempotency key and a retry in the same hour
trivial: a null check, a missing await, ten local lines with an existing test to extend
bounded: a new branch in a route plus its unit and route tests
structural: a migration or new persisted state
